display_long_description:
Welcome to Marmo Mayham!

Swing, climb, and explore your way through a vibrant forest built for fast-paced movement and endless fun. Inspired by the freedom of classic gorilla-style locomotion, Marmo Mayham challenges you to master your movement as you race through the environment, discover hidden paths, and play with friends.

Traverse towering trees, cross rope bridges, and uncover every corner of the map using only your arms. Whether you're practicing advanced movement techniques, exploring the world, or hanging out in multiplayer, there's always something to do.

Features
🌳 Large forest environment filled with places to explore.
🪢 Rope bridges and climbable structures.
🦍 Smooth gorilla-style locomotion designed for VR.
👥 Multiplayer gameplay with friends.
🎩 Unlock and equip cosmetics to customize your look.
⚡ Fast-paced movement that rewards skill and practice.
🔄 Ongoing updates with new maps, cosmetics, and gameplay improvements.

Whether you're competing to become the fastest climber or simply exploring the world, Marmo Mayham offers an exciting VR playground for players of all skill levels.

Grab your headset, jump into the forest, and see how far your skills can take you!
